name: text-shimmer
title: Text shimmer
author: Eduardo Retana
description: A calm light across a short status line while work is ongoing. Sets aria-busy.

meta.descriptionEs: Una luz recorre una línea corta de estado mientras el trabajo sigue. Marca aria-busy.

examples.title: Texto con brillo
examples.description: Una luz recorre una línea corta de estado mientras el trabajo sigue. Marca aria-busy.

api.name: children
api.description: Status text. Keep it to one short line.

api.name: active
api.description: Sweep while work continues. Default true.

docs: Adapted from Arc UI (MIT). Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors. Motion is skipped when the reader prefers reduced motion.
